name: datashield-desktop
description: DataShield 数据合规桌面版（Electron + 内嵌 FastAPI 后端）

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:18321 http://localhost:5173 && cross-env DESKTOP_DEV=1 DESKTOP_DEV_API=http://127.0.0.1:18321/api electron ."
scripts.build:backend: cd ../backend && python -m PyInstaller datashield-backend.spec --distpath dist --workpath build --noconfirm
scripts.dist: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis
